detail: When the command against Mithridates is taken from Sulla and given to Marius, Sulla marches his army on Rome, the first general to do so. He then goes east and forces Mithridates to make peace in 85 BCE.
label: 88 BCE
note: Added for context; not from the reading notes.
title: Sulla marches on Rome
tldr: Sulla is the first general to march his army on Rome, and later rules as dictator.
